kind: prospective repair specification; source remains R38
safe_prewrite_conjunction: attempt token fresh and bound to this checkpoint/stream
known synchronous predicate rejects before destructive open or write-may-start boundary
journal healthy at entry and exclusively owned existing handle with coherent acknowledged prefix
no identity/reparse/link/extent conflict observed and no unresolved trust error
all effects/debits/attempt counters retained, including prewrite debit

transitions.budget: retain exact already-spent counters and debit; zero automatic release

transitions.event: ownership or identity integrity conflict before payload write

transitions.budget: retain full debit; never retry uncertain attempt

boundary_rules: set write-may-start marker before protected call; interruption before/within call may conservatively count as possibly attempted
never certify PREWRITE from Refusal class, errno, text, or zero byte delta alone
uninitialized/stale marker, reentry, allocation failure during classification => conservative unknown and fail closed
token creation/consumption belongs to existing io_lock; source calls direct checkpoint and safe/commit must all receive fresh token
safe classification never turns poisoned=true to false; it prevents an unjustified new transition only
evidence_fields_required: rejection site and stable producer code
representation_rule: same existing lossless journal/artifact envelopes, original observations and failed-attempt facts retained; minimal fixed bounded transaction facts are extra L0 and need new capacity accounting
